verdict: Organic presence holds; overdue pipeline blockers need resolution this month.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, every trackable result came from organic Google Business Profile activity — paid channels recorded zero spend and zero leads. Combined, your profiles generated 455 total actions (21 calls, 320 directions, 114 web clicks) over 28 days, with Advance Grinding Services showing the strongest momentum at +36% week-over-week. O'Hare and Forte both saw GBP engagement soften in the final days of the period, and that trend is being watched closely. The more pressing matter is a set of CRM, outreach, and web milestones that are now 10 to 97 days overdue — these are the blockers standing between your current organic activity and a functioning lead pipeline, and resolving them is the priority for the next 30 days.

watch_item.fix: CRM blockers and the web fix are the immediate focus this month; outreach sequences and tracking restoration are queued to follow as each blocker clears, with full automations and a next calling wave targeted by October 31.
